decisionRationale: Proceed past the Issue 02 boundary gate after the timed public-seam samples and compiler-resolution regressions pass. Three fixtures match the immutable upstream oracle exactly; the React fixture matches the complete tracked TS7 oracle and exact warning oracle with explicit generic alias and mapped-alias coverage, while the type-operator policy remains configurable and the exact React divergence leaves are mechanically accounted for. The required module-resolution operation is consumed by the parser and the measured aggregate IPC round-trip remains below the checked-in stop threshold.

notes: export type * from ./source.js resolves to source.d.ts
type exports are retained and runtime exports are filtered from the star
non-relative path mapping resolves through the compiler symbol graph
package exports resolve through the compiler symbol graph

backendLeakage.evidence: test/boundary.test.ts and scripts/issue-02-timing.ts scan static, dynamic, template, and type-only import forms; only src/backend/ts7/** imports typescript/unstable/*

durableContractLeakage.evidence: backend contracts, parser, model, warnings, errors, provenance, and ProjectExtractor expose only package-owned records; BackendProject.extractModule is absent and resolveModule is required

unacceptableIpcGrowth.evidence: test/fixtures/issue-02-timing.json records all four sequential public-seam samples and the checked command recomputes the decision without exact-latency equality

scopeEvidence.generic: boundary-covered: explicit generic arguments and two-hop mapped aliases
scopeEvidence.typeOperator: policy-preserved: resolved and syntax-only modes remain available; broader conformance is deferred
scopeEvidence.react: boundary-covered: compound component transform with a reviewed TS7 external-graph divergence

residualRisk: TypeScript 7 unstable APIs may change in a future compiler release; the unstable import seam limits the intended blast radius.
External React conditional and recursive graphs remain an explicit reviewed TS7 fidelity divergence and require a future compatibility decision before claiming upstream React equality.
Timing totals are environment-dependent evidence; the report checks signs, availability, fixture coverage, and a broad aggregate threshold rather than exact latency.
